fields.help_en: The ID of the project to which the integration pipeline node belongs

fields.help_en:
The current operating environment. Valid values:
- DEV: the development environment.
- PROD: the production environment
fields.help_zh: 当前操作环境env：DEV-表示操作开发环境，PROD-表示操作生产环境
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to delete the node
fields.name: delete

fields.help_en: The scheduling node ID of the integration node. You can specify any one of PipelineId, FileId, or NodeId

fields.help_en: The primary key of the integration pipeline. You can specify any one of PipelineId, FileId, or NodeId

fields.name: pipeline_id

fields.help_en: The file ID of the integration node. You can specify any one of PipelineId, FileId, or NodeId
fields.help_zh: 支持使用集成任务文件fileId查询，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId设置任意一个即可
